entries.name: Colony
entries.flavor: Home to settlers and basic services.

entries.name: Frontier
entries.flavor: Open country beyond the colony lights.

entries.name: Derelict
entries.flavor: Airlocks sealed for a long time.

entries.name: Jump Gate
entries.flavor: Step through, another sky.

entries.name: Memorial
entries.flavor: Names of the lost are read here.

entries.name: Arena
entries.flavor: Scoreboards, not body bags.

entries.name: Respawn
entries.flavor: Wake up somewhere familiar.

entries.name: Monoblade
entries.flavor: One molecule wide, all edge.

entries.name: Stim
entries.flavor: A hiss, then steady hands.

entries.name: Hologram
entries.flavor: Light that talks back.

entries.name: Target Drone
entries.flavor: It holds still on purpose.

entries.name: First Clear
entries.flavor: Someone has to be first.

entries.name: Revival
entries.flavor: A new body, same record.

entries.name: Transcend
entries.flavor: The ladder ends; the climb doesn't.

entries.name: Fleet Admiral
entries.flavor: The Registry has no higher line.

entries.name: Meridian Port
entries.flavor: A colony port on the ring, neon over rust.

entries.name: Survey Hall
entries.flavor: Routes and star charts are filed here.

entries.name: Orbital Berth
entries.flavor: Credits settle at the berth.

entries.name: Simulation Bay
entries.flavor: Shoot down one target drone to pass.

entries.name: Salvage Yard
entries.flavor: A half-lawful salvage point.

entries.name: Rust Belt
entries.flavor: Entry is voluntary; private fights stand.

entries.name: Black Lane
entries.flavor: Entry is voluntary; private fights stand.

entries.name: Fleet Registry
entries.flavor: Residents and drifters are both enrolled.

entries.name: Deep Survey Corps
entries.flavor: They chart routes out in the black.

entries.name: Orbital Trade Compact
entries.flavor: They run the trade stations and the credits.

entries.name: Rustfield Salvage Crew
entries.flavor: They pull relics out of the wreck belts.

entries.name: Confluence Exchange
entries.flavor: Every world-gate opens onto this exchange, and the four fleets trade here.

entries.name: Duel Pit
entries.flavor: A sunken pit ringed with watching galleries.

entries.name: Grayhaven Outpost
entries.flavor: The sentry post of an outlying garrison port, and a revival point.

entries.name: Silver Candle Lab
entries.flavor: The training laboratory of an outlying research group.

entries.name: Greenpath Waystation
entries.flavor: The supply waystation of an outlying escort company, which also trades.

entries.name: Harbor-Edge Range
entries.flavor: The introductory firing range at the harbor's edge, where newcomers test their aim.

entries.name: Grayhaven Float
entries.flavor: A floating platform at the outlying port, where supplies can be gathered.

entries.name: Harbor Flats
entries.flavor: The tidal stretch outside the harbor, open for gathering.

entries.name: Greenpath Bog
entries.flavor: A low bog where bio-samples grow.

entries.name: Old Tomb Pod
entries.flavor: An old burial pod sunk under the soil.

entries.name: Tomb Pod Lower Deck
entries.flavor: The deep deck of the burial pod, entered only by choice.

entries.name: Gray Spine
entries.flavor: A gray ridge outside the harbor, and the route is not quiet.

entries.name: Gray Spine Pit
entries.flavor: A pit under the ridge, entered only by choice.

entries.name: Haven Memorial
entries.flavor: A small memorial at the edge of the outlying port town.

entries.name: Qingxi Convoy Hall
entries.flavor: An outlying hall that escorts cargo and travelers.

entries.name: Qingxi Relay Road
entries.flavor: The relay road outside the convoy office.

entries.name: Qingxi Ridge
entries.flavor: Bio-samples can be gathered on this ridge.

entries.name: Pinewind Drill Bay
entries.flavor: An outlying bay where close combat is taught.

entries.name: Pine-Shadow Target Lane
entries.flavor: Target drones line the lane for newcomers to try their hand.

entries.name: Qingxi Ford
entries.flavor: A ford on the creek, with supplies gathered along the bank.

entries.flavor: A station that gathers and studies bio-samples, and repairs gear.

entries.name: Pinewind Memorial Post
entries.flavor: A small memorial post standing under the pines.

entries.name: Broken-Cliff Walkway
entries.flavor: A narrow walkway along the broken cliff, entered only by choice.

entries.name: Broken-Wall Pit
entries.flavor: A ruin with half its wall left, entered only by choice, private fights not judged.

entries.name: Rolls Office
entries.flavor: Where outlying newcomers are registered and trained.

entries.name: Trial Drone Lane
entries.flavor: Training drones line the lane, and every newcomer wins one bout.

entries.name: Peach Slope
entries.flavor: A slope planted with rows of peach trees.

entries.name: Sample Field
entries.flavor: A whole field planted with bio-samples.

entries.name: Morning Dew Pool

entries.name: Silverblade Academy
entries.flavor: The training hall of an outlying sword company, inside its gate.

entries.name: Gate Arena
entries.flavor: The sparring ground before the gate, entered only by choice.

entries.name: Ninefold Dispensary

entries.name: Cloud-Pattern Data Tower
